item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 08:20 PM 05 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Victoria, Socorro, Pola, Pinamalayan, Naujan, Roxas, Mansalay, Bulalacao, CityOfCalapan, Baco, SanTeodoro, PuertoGalera), #Masbate(Palanas, Uson, Dimasalang, Mandaon, Claveria, Mobo, Batuan), #Albay(Oas, CityOfLigao, PioDuran), #Sorsogon(Donsol), #Catanduanes(Bato, SanMiguel, Baras), #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Calabanga, Libmanan, Pasacao, Pamplona, Cabusao, Sipocot), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Basud), #NorthernSamar(SanVicente, Capul, SanAntonio and SanIsidro) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Placer, Esperanza, Cataingan, PioV.Corpuz, Cawayan, Balud and Milagros) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
